question: total residential building area km2
sql:
WITH res AS (
  SELECT ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) AS area_m2
  FROM lisbon_buildings
  WHERE subtype = 'residential'
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(area_m2) / 1e6, 3) AS total_residential_area_km2
FROM res;

question: longest road segment length m and class
sql:
WITH seg AS (
  SELECT class,
         ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry) AS len_m
  FROM lisbon_roads
)
SELECT class,
       ROUND(len_m, 2) AS length_m
FROM seg
ORDER BY len_m DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: average building height per roof shape
sql:
SELECT roof_shape,
       ROUND(AVG(height), 2) AS avg_height_m,
       COUNT(*) AS building_count
FROM lisbon_buildings
GROUP BY roof_shape
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY avg_height_m DESC;

question: total footway length km
sql:
WITH foot AS (
  SELECT ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry) AS len_m
  FROM lisbon_roads
  WHERE class = 'footway'
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(len_m) / 1000, 3) AS total_footway_km
FROM foot;

question: tall buildings >100m footprint area and geojson
sql:
SELECT id,
       height,
       ROUND(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry), 2) AS area_m2,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson
FROM lisbon_buildings
WHERE height > 100
LIMIT 10;

question: average max speed km/h for residential roads
sql:
WITH sl AS (
  SELECT sl.max_speed.value AS max_speed_kmh
  FROM lisbon_roads,
       UNNEST(speed_limits) AS sl
  WHERE class = 'residential'
    AND sl.max_speed.value IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(max_speed_kmh), 1) AS avg_max_speed_kmh
FROM sl;
